mechanism_narrative: A rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the prior month signals imminent monetary tightening that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months where FEDFUNDS rises by at least 0.05% in the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 10.0% (UNRATE > 10.0%) indicates severe labor market distress that suppresses consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months with UNRATE > 10.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in unemployment (UNRATE) and declines in payrolls (PAYEMS) signal accelerating labor market deterioration that reduces consumer confidence and spending, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE rises >0.2pp and PAYEMS falls >50k in prior month, SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In the post-recession recovery regime, synchronized growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals strengthening consumer demand that boosts corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In post-recession recovery, when HOUST and RSAFS both rise >1.0% in prior month, SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Rising CPI (CPIAUCSL) over the prior month indicates accelerating inflation that triggers Fed policy tightening, reducing equity valuations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months where CPIAUCSL rises >0.2% in prior month.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production below 100.0 (INDPRO < 100.0) signals manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate output and profits, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months with INDPRO < 100.0.

mechanism_narrative: In the early recovery regime, positive real GDP growth (GDPC1) signals improving economic fundamentals that drive S&P 500 gains over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In early-recovery, when GDPC1 shows positive quarterly growth, SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the prior three months signals accommodative monetary policy that lifts equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in less than 40% of months where FEDFUNDS declines >0.1% in prior three months.
